goal: Integrate the causal rolling public-start estimator, qualify it, execute one finite chronological probe and deliver all-parameter/current-state traces with an honest update slide.

ownership.common_prior: original supported joint mixture, once per objective, never merged into likelihood
ownership.record_commit: one row per chronological record, retire raw block after complete commit

trace_contract.truth_scoring: external reporting only after whole-process candidate closure
trace_contract.convergence_claim: Only as supported by actual evidence; flat, biased, unresolved and failed traces remain explicit.
trace_contract.intervals: Not generated or validated by this integration.

phases: one canonical stream with exclusive captures
failure_policy: Preserve every reservation, failed invocation and partial capture. No automatic scientific retry or undeclared extension. Any necessary correction requires a separately named, explained attempt.
promotion: Experimental candidate only. Complete target SRAM/timing, long-run fidelity, robustness and calibrated uncertainty remain M3 gates.
